summary: Ameresco filed an 8-K reporting entry into a contribution and equity purchase agreement to form a joint venture, Neogenyx Fuels LLC, with an affiliate of HASI. Ameresco contributes its biogas business for a 70% equity interest, while HASI invests $400 million for a 30% interest. The investment partially goes to Ameresco, debt reduction, and JV funding. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions with a termination date of June 3, 2026. This JV formation does not neatly fit a standard M&A or restructuring category; it is a business combination via contribution. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing mechanics.
